errors.evidence: The X-axis in the figure has no label. The description invents the label "Тримесечие" (Quarter).

errors.text_span: Етикетите са зададени за всяко тримесечие
errors.evidence: The labels on the x-axis are not for every quarter; they appear at irregular, multi-quarter intervals.

The list of x-axis labels provided in the description is almost entirely incorrect. For example, the description lists 2007Q1, 2008Q2, 2009Q3, etc., while the figure shows 2008Q1, 2009Q2, 2010Q3, etc.

errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена като "Брой наети лица"
errors.evidence: The Y-axis has no label. The description incorrectly uses the chart's title "Общо Наети лица" (Total Employed Persons) as the axis label.
The starting value of the line at 2003Q1 is approximately 2300, not 2600.0.
The maximum value reached by the line is just below 3000.0, not 3300.0.
The peak of the line occurs around 2008Q1/Q2, not 2007Q2.
After the peak, the line drops to a low point of approximately 2550-2600, not 2700.0.
The low point after the initial peak occurs around 2010, not 2009Q3.
The final value of the line at 2021Q4 is closer to 2700-2750, not 2800.0.
